punti.fonte: EUNAVFOR Atalanta, Political and Security Committee of the EU visits Atalanta flagship in Djibouti
punti.note: Flagship of EU Operation Atalanta (Task Force 465) since 10 October, with Portuguese Commodore Jose Rodrigues Pedra commanding the 54th rotation. Moored in Djibouti on 3 November for a visit by the EU Political and Security Committee; embarks an SH-60B and a ScanEagle drone. Atalanta has handled seven piracy cases off Somalia and Yemen since April 2026.

punti.fonte: USNI News, EU needs more ships for Red Sea; European navies adjust Hormuz deployments
punti.note: Named by USNI on 28 September as flagship of EU Operation Aspides, which escorts merchant ships against Houthi attacks. On 12 October Euronews wrote that Italy and Greece supply the mission's three core ships and that only the Netherlands and Belgium had offered one more ship each; EU High Representative Kallas said at least ten are needed. No newer dated position found.

punti.fonte: Zone Militaire (opex360), French frigate shot down a drone threatening the container ship Champs-Elysees (confirmed by the French Joint Staff)
punti.note: One of two French frigates deployed near Bab el-Mandeb. In the night of 1-2 October it shot down with its gun a drone approaching the CMA CGM container ship Champs-Elysees in the strait (Le Monde, confirmed by the French Joint Staff). The French Joint Staff said in mid-October that its Aspides frigate escorts about two ships a day.

punti.nome: C-17 e C-5 USA a Incirlik
punti.fonte: Davide Montingelli (YouTube), «Dietro le linee», minuto 0:00
punti.note: Destinazione dei voli del ponte aereo USA nelle due settimane prima della diretta, secondo Davide Montingelli, che cita mappatori non nominati: circa 92 voli di C-17 e C-5 tra il 29 settembre e il 29 ottobre, dagli Stati Uniti all'Europa e poi verso Turchia, Israele e Golfo. Il punto è la destinazione, non un aereo visto. Diretta registrata intorno al 3 novembre.
